svg.aria-label: Ankit Verma, mobile software engineer. Ships to Android and iOS. Currently learning Compose Multiplatform. Favourite kind of bug: the crash that only shows up after you open the same screen again, and again, and again. Based in India. Beyond mobile: AR and geospatial, on-device ML, tools for AI agents.
